Potential isn’t patient. It unfolds where strategy and execution meet.

The RMR Group (Nasdaq: RMR) is a nationally integrated commercial real estate platform managing over $37 billion in assets across multiple sectors. For nearly four decades, we’ve operated at the intersection of insight and execution: identifying opportunity early, acting with precision and delivering results through cycles. We combine the scale of an institutional platform with the agility of an operator, partnering closely with investors, tenants and stakeholders to create long-term value. Our diversified model spans property management, asset management, capital formation, development and strategic operations, designed to anticipate market needs and respond decisively. Our platform brings insight, experience and execution together across every sector of commercial real estate. We see what a property can become and align our teams and partners to bring that potential to life with speed and impact.
*As of June 30, 2026
We don’t just react to the market. We anticipate it. Through data, experience and instinct, we identify opportunity before it’s obvious. Explore some of our projects currently in motion.

111 Cinema Drive: Ground-Up Student Housing

Located just one mile from the University of North Carolina Wilmington, the 8.6‑acre, shovel‑ready site will be transformed from a vacant AMC theater into a fully amenitized, modern housing option designed to meet strong and growing demand from upperclassmen and graduate students.
2141 K Street NW: Office-to-Residential Conversion in Washington, D.C.

North Station Gateway: Landmark Mixed-Use Development

Designed to serve as a true gateway between downtown Boston and its northern neighborhoods, the North Station Gateway project will introduce new residential, hospitality and retail offerings to one of the city’s most dynamic and rapidly evolving districts.
Office-to-Multifamily Transformation in Reston, VA
Transforming an obsolete office park into a vibrant, transit-oriented multifamily community.
The best partnerships don’t just manage capital. They create new chapters of growth.

We believe the strongest partnerships aren’t transactional. They’re transformational. That’s why we invest alongside our clients, share their risk and work relentlessly to make them look brilliant. With the scale of a national platform and the service culture of a boutique firm, we turn partnership into a lasting strategic advantage.
Behind every number, there’s a name.

At RMR, our greatest asset isn’t on a balance sheet. It’s our people. Real estate is in their DNA. From street-level operators to sector experts, our teams bring a hands-on understanding of how to navigate markets, manage risk and create lasting value.

pages.raw_title: About RMR | Real Estate Investment & Integrated Platform
pages.raw_meta: RMR is a leading U.S. real estate investment manager with an integrated national platform, diversified strategies and a commitment to unlocking long‑term value.
raw_blocks: A Legacy of Leadership in Real Estate
Built on a legacy of disciplined execution and entrepreneurial thinking, we operate with a simple belief: potential isn’t patient, and neither are we.
RMR is a leading U.S. real estate investment manager with more than four decades of experience creating value across commercial real estate, private capital and credit strategies.

Our roots run deep in real estate, but our vision is forward-looking. Today, RMR manages a diverse platform of publicly traded REITs, a growing private capital business anchored by multifamily and commercial real estate lending and a nationwide operating infrastructure that gives us reach, insight and speed few can match.

Our mission: Create long-term value for our clients by managing their investments and assets with an ownership mindset. Our hands-on approach drives performance, unlocks opportunity and builds trust - empowering employees, investors and stakeholders to thrive.

Our vision : Leadership is earned through performance, discipline and foresight. We've proven our position as a trusted manager and aim to build on this foundation by expanding our reach, deepening expertise and unlocking opportunities for long-term value creation.

Powered by a vertically integrated platform and deep operational foundation, we identify opportunity early, act with conviction and deliver through market cycles. With reach across both public and private markets and expertise spanning all major real estate sectors, we transform potential into measurable outcomes.

Through our family of publicly traded REITs, we provide access to diversified commercial real estate strategies across office, retail, senior living and healthcare and net lease sectors. Our REITs combine long-term ownership, disciplined capital allocation and operational excellence supported by our national platform.
Diversified Healthcare Trust | ~$6.8B AUM - Senior living, life sciences and medical office properties across 33 states and Washington, D.C. (Nasdaq: DHC).
Industrial Logistics Properties Trust | $2.6B AUM - Industrial and logistics assets located across 39 states, including strategic holdings in Oahu, Hawaii. (Nasdaq: ILPT).
Office Properties Income Trust | $5.4B AUM - Office and mixed-use properties, primarily leased to investment grade tenants. (Nasdaq: OPI).
Service Properties Trust | $9.9B AUM - Diversified portfolio of service-focused retail net lease properties and hotels in the U.S., Puerto Rico and Canada. (Nasdaq: SVC).
Seven Hills Realty Trust | $738M AUM - Originates and invests in first mortgage loans for transitional commercial real estate. (Nasdaq: SEVN).
RMR offers a growing suite of private investment strategies designed for today’s evolving real estate landscape, including:

Separate accounts : Customized solutions designed to align with investor-specific mandates, offering full transparency and control over asset selection, while benefiting from RMR's dedicated asset and management expertise and operational resources.
Joint ventures : Strategic partnerships offering access to RMR's best ideas, cross-sector expertise and vertically integrated platform demonstrated by a proven track record of value creation.
Traditional funds : Thematic, operator-led approach to investing, targeting the most compelling relative value and risk-adjusted opportunities across sectors and throughout the capital stack.
Our ability to structure capital creatively - equity, debt or hybrid - allows us to match each opportunity with the right strategy and partner.

From street-level operators to sector-specific experts, our people drive our performance. With deep experience across every major asset class, our team brings a deep understanding of how to navigate markets, manage risk and unlock value. Our culture is entrepreneurial, innovative and built on insight.

Our vertically integrated platform is where potential becomes tangible. By uniting leasing, engineering and essential support services – including IT, recruiting and marketing – with core capabilities in acquisition, development, financing and operations, we deliver a holistic approach to asset management.

Meaningful partnerships are built on alignment, not transactions. We work alongside investors, sharing risk and shaping strategy together. Combining the reach of a national platform with the agility of a boutique firm, we deliver solutions that anticipate market trends and set new benchmarks for performance.
